title: Proposed study collaboration on CPLX1-related disorders

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on CPLX1-related disorders
Dear [the patient organisation], I am [name, role, institution], and I hope you might help us think about a study in CPLX1-related disorders.
Our atlas lists no patient organisation for this condition, so I am writing to [the patient organisation] in the hope that it serves these families.
Published work links CPLX1-related disorders to loss of function, but the authors flag the evidence as limited.
The atlas lists no registry, natural history study or clinical trial for this condition.
That gap is part of why we would like to start by listening.
We would propose [study aim and design], developed with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and whether your community could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
Thank you very much for considering this.
